method: The listed couscous quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.

Use instant couscous suitable for preparation with boiling water. Put the measured dry couscous in a heatproof bowl, pour over the boiling-water quantity stated on its packet, cover and leave for the packet time. Fluff with a fork; it should be tender with no hard grains.
Wash the cucumber and tomato, then dice both into small pieces.
Choose firm tofu labelled ready to eat. Drain and pat it dry, then cut it into small cubes; keep it chilled until assembly.
Stir together all the measured lemon juice, wholegrain mustard and olive oil in a small bowl to make the dressing. Keep it refrigerated until assembly.
Fold the cooked couscous, cucumber, tomato and prepared ready-to-eat filling together with the prepared dressing. Eat immediately.

For a packed lunch, cool the prepared couscous promptly before combining it with the chilled filling. Cover, refrigerate and eat within 24 hours, following any shorter ingredient use-by date. Keep the meal chilled until eating.

review.notes: Cooked fluffy couscous with small pale unseared firm tofu cubes, diced raw cucumber/tomato and lemon/wholegrain-mustard/oil dressing folded through. Mustard grains in dressing, no scatter garnish, feta or citrus wedge. Exact title/method checked.
